order_description: Small clue: some of these stand much higher above the ground than others.
prompt: Create one 1x5 horizontal strip of five separate square rounded-corner icon cards in this exact order: Christ the Redeemer, Statue of Liberty, Big Ben, Space Needle, Eiffel Tower. Each card has transparent background outside the rounded tile, a simple warm flat colored tile inside, and a centered cartoony landmark icon representing the landmark. Match the attached coffee mug icon style: flat cartoony illustration, clean dark outline, subtle flat shading, warm highlight, consistent scale and camera angle, polished casual game asset, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no labels, no UI, no logos.
